$comment: The axes of the shared internal-reference gate (@cosyte/script-utils, `cosyte-internal-refs`, ST34) for this repository: no item identifiers, phase or wave words, ADR numbers, internal paths or traceability markers on what a consumer reads. That is the README, LICENSE, docs-content/, the npm description and keywords, the doc comments that compile into the shipped declarations, and the string literals in src/, which reach a consumer as a disposition message a consumer reads in their logs.
The samples are the ones this repository's own gate carried, so every self-test it ran still runs here.

slice-after-the-or-each and phase-before-a-prose-word keep what this repository's own gate caught and the shared rules let through since 0.1.5 and 0.1.6: `the` and `each` before `slice`, and `phase` before a prose word or after a hyphenated word.
roadmap-section: this repository cited its roadmap by section (`roadmap §4.6`, `roadmap §Phase 8`). A bare `§` is how it cites 45 CFR 164.514, so that sample is a negative of every rule.
